title: Ghost Hand
synopsis: This is Part 8 of our rendition of “Ghost Hand”.

fullText.simplified:
霍桑打开盒子，里面有一本很小的笔记本和一个小袋子。笔记本上写满了字，霍桑想这应该是李单的字。他坐在沙发上，用最快的速度看完了笔记本上的字，他发现，这是一个很伟大的海军计划！
    霍桑想起了李时说的，他的曾祖父和李鸿章是好朋友，曾经向李鸿章提出过一个伟大的建议，但是李鸿章没有听他的话。现在看来，那个伟大的建议，应该就是这笔记本上的海军计划了。虽然这个计划放到现在已经没有多大用处了，但是如果当时能实现这个计划，说不定甲午战争就不会战败了。
    笔记本的最后一页，是李单要告诉子孙们的话。上面写着：子孙们，如果以后有机会，你们一定要实现这个海军计划。小袋子里有我在德国得到的十颗钻石。这些钻石要用来帮助国家实现这个海军计划，不能用在别的地方。”
    霍桑打开小袋子，果然里面有十颗美丽的钻石。看到钻石，霍桑眼里放着光。而旁边的侍女小凤，从来没有见过钻石，更是张着口，说不出一句话来。
    霍桑看了小凤一眼，把钻石放回小袋子中，再把笔记本和小袋子都放到了自己的口袋里。接着，他把铜像的头部放回了原来的地方，再盖上了红布。现在，这铜像看上去就像从来没有被碰过的一样。
    霍桑对小凤说：“今天辛苦你了。现在你可以回房间睡觉了。这钻石，就算是给我的封口费了。另外，你那个姓朱的情人并不是什么好东西，你要小心。”
    小凤慢慢地向门口走去，到了门口，又转回头，问：“霍先生，那钻石你不还给主人吗？”
    霍桑抬起头，轻轻地笑道：“我为什么要还？是我找到的钻石。”
    小凤听后，有点生气地说道：“你可是全国有名的霍桑大侦探啊！怎么能这样？”
    霍桑笑了，说道：“谁告诉你我是霍桑的？”
    “你不是霍先生？那……那你是谁？”小凤看着眼前这个人，惊得声音都发抖了起来。
    “哈哈！我是一名侠盗，或者，你可以叫我——小偷？我只不过是那天看霍桑事务所没人，偷偷进去“拿”了点东西，正好接到了你主人的电话……。”
    “那你的名字是……？”小凤接着问。
    这名侠盗没有回答，只是对她笑了笑，慢慢地走出了房间，离开了这个小洋楼。小凤只记得，在他经过她时，他耳朵上的那块印记，特别大、特别红。

    这天晚上的事，除了侍女小凤，没有人知道。而小凤，当然不会把这件事说出来。三天后，李时收到了一封信，是“霍桑”写的。信很短，上面写着：“那天晚上的‘鬼手’，不是鬼，而是你的好朋友朱龙。他这么做，是想要偷走你脖子上辟邪的小宝物。”和信在一起的，还有一本笔记本。李时发现，这是他曾祖父的笔记本。他不明白这本他从来没有见过的笔记本，怎么会到了霍桑手中。他摇摇头，把笔记本放到了一边。这位每天只知道玩儿的李时先生，从来没有想过要好好读一读这本笔记本。所以他到最后也没能知道，铜像、钻石还有那“鬼手”的真正目的……
fullText.traditional:
霍桑打開盒子，裡面有一本很小的筆記本和一個小袋子。筆記本上寫滿了字，霍桑想這應該是李單的字。他坐在沙發上，用最快的速度看完了筆記本上的字，他發現，這是一個很偉大的海軍計劃！
    霍桑想起了李時說的，他的曾祖父和李鴻章是好朋友，曾經向李鴻章提出過一個偉大的建議，但是李鴻章沒有聽他的話。現在看來，那個偉大的建議，應該就是這筆記本上的海軍計劃了。雖然這個計劃放到現在已經沒有多大用處了，但是如果當時能實現這個計劃，說不定甲午戰爭就不會戰敗了。
    筆記本的最後一頁，是李單要告訴子孫們的話。上面寫著：子孫們，如果以後有機會，你們一定要實現這個海軍計劃。小袋子裡有我在德國得到的十顆鑽石。這些鑽石要用來幫助國家實現這個海軍計劃，不能用在別的地方。”
    霍桑打開小袋子，果然裡面有十顆美麗的鑽石。看到鑽石，霍桑眼裡放著光。而旁邊的侍女小鳳，從來沒有見過鑽石，更是張著口，說不出一句話來。
    霍桑看了小鳳一眼，把鑽石放回小袋子中，再把筆記本和小袋子都放到了自己的口袋裡。接著，他把銅像的頭部放回了原來的地方，再蓋上了紅布。現在，這銅像看上去就像從來沒有被碰過的一樣。
    霍桑對小鳳說：“今天辛苦你了。現在你可以回房間睡覺了。這鑽石，就算是給我的封口費了。另外，你那個姓朱的情人並不是什麼好東西，你要小心。”
    小鳳慢慢地向門口走去，到了門口，又轉回頭，問：“霍先生，那鑽石你不還給主人嗎？”
    霍桑抬起頭，輕輕地笑道：“我為什麼要還？是我找到的鑽石。”
    小鳳聽後，有點生氣地說道：“你可是全國有名的霍桑大偵探啊！怎麼能這樣？”
    霍桑笑了，說道：“誰告訴你我是霍桑的？”
    “你不是霍先生？那……那你是誰？”小鳳看著眼前這個人，驚得聲音都發抖了起來。
    “哈哈！我是一名俠盜，或者，你可以叫我——小偷？我只不過是那天看霍桑事務所沒人，偷偷進去“拿”了點東西，正好接到了你主人的電話……。”
    “那你的名字是……？”小鳳接著問。
    這名俠盜沒有回答，只是對她笑了笑，慢慢地走出了房間，離開了這個小洋樓。小鳳只記得，在他經過她時，他耳朵上的那塊印記，特別大、特別紅。

    這天晚上的事，除了侍女小鳳，沒有人知道。而小鳳，當然不會把這件事說出來。三天後，李時收到了一封信，是“霍桑”寫的。信很短，上面寫著：“那天晚上的‘鬼手’，不是鬼，而是你的好朋友朱龍。他這麼做，是想要偷走你脖子上辟邪的小寶物。”和信在一起的，還有一本筆記本。李時發現，這是他曾祖父的筆記本。他不明白這本他從來沒有見過的筆記本，怎麼會到了霍桑手中。他搖搖頭，把筆記本放到了一邊。這位每天只知道玩兒的李時先生，從來沒有想過要好好讀一讀這本筆記本。所以他到最後也沒能知道，銅像、鑽石還有那“鬼手”的真正目的……

sentences.pinyin: nǐ bú shì huò xiān sheng nà nà nǐ shì shéi

sentences.simplified: 小凤看着眼前这个人，惊得声音都发抖了起来。
sentences.traditional: 小鳳看著眼前這個人，驚得聲音都發抖了起來。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo fèng kàn zhe yǎn qián zhè ge rén jīng de shēng yīn dōu fā dǒu le qǐ lái
sentences.english: “You’re not Mr. Huo? Then… Then who are you?”
Xiaofeng looked at this person before her eyes, so scared that her voice started trembling completely.

sentences.simplified: “哈哈！我是一名侠盗，或者，你可以叫我——小偷？
sentences.traditional: “哈哈！我是一名俠盜，或者，你可以叫我——小偷？
sentences.pinyin: hā hā wǒ shì yì míng xiá dào huò zhě nǐ kě yǐ jiào wǒ xiǎo tōu

sentences.simplified: 我只不过是那天看霍桑事务所没人，偷偷进去“拿”了点东西，
sentences.traditional: 我只不過是那天看霍桑事務所沒人，偷偷進去“拿”了點東西，
sentences.pinyin: wǒ zhǐ bu guò shì nà tiān kàn huò sāng shì wù suǒ méi rén tōu tōu jìn qù ná le diǎn dōng xi
sentences.english: “Haha! I’m a master thief, or, you can call me – a thief?

sentences.simplified: 正好接到了你主人的电话……。”
sentences.traditional: 正好接到了你主人的電話……。”
sentences.pinyin: zhèng hǎo jiē dào le nǐ zhǔ rén de diàn huà
sentences.english: I merely saw that Huo Sang’s office was empty that day, sneaked in to “seize” some things, ..
.. just in time to receive the phone call about your master…”

sentences.simplified: “那你的名字是……？”小凤接着问。
sentences.traditional: “那你的名字是……？”小鳳接著問。
sentences.pinyin: nà nǐ de míng zi shì xiǎo fèng jiē zhe wèn

sentences.english: “Then your name is…?” Xiaofeng then asked.

sentences.simplified: 这名侠盗没有回答，只是对她笑了笑，慢慢地走出了房间，离开了这个小洋楼。
sentences.traditional: 這名俠盜沒有回答，只是對她笑了笑，慢慢地走出了房間，離開了這個小洋樓。
sentences.pinyin: zhè míng xiá dào méi yǒu huí dá zhǐ shì duì tā xiào le xiào màn man de zǒu chū le fáng jiān lí kāi le zhè ge xiǎo yáng lóu

sentences.simplified: 小凤只记得，在他经过她时，他耳朵上的那块印记，特别大、特别红。
sentences.traditional: 小鳳只記得，在他經過她時，他耳朵上的那塊印記，特別大、特別紅。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo fèng zhǐ jì de zài tā jīng guò tā shí tā ěr duo shang de nà kuài yìn jì tè bié dà tè bié hóng
sentences.english: This master thief didn’t answer, just smiled at her, slowly walked out the room, and left this small Western-style house.
Xiaofeng only remembered, when he passed her, that mark on his ear, that was particularly big and particularly red.

sentences.simplified: 这天晚上的事，除了侍女小凤，没有人知道。
sentences.traditional: 這天晚上的事，除了侍女小鳳，沒有人知道。
sentences.pinyin: zhè tiān wǎn shang de shì chú le shì nǚ xiǎo fèng méi yǒu rén zhī dào

sentences.simplified: 而小凤，当然不会把这件事说出来。
sentences.traditional: 而小鳳，當然不會把這件事說出來。
sentences.pinyin: ér xiǎo fèng dāng rán bú huì bǎ zhè jiàn shì shuō chū lái
sentences.english: No one knew about the matter of this evening, other than Miss Xiaofeng.

sentences.simplified: 三天后，李时收到了一封信，是“霍桑”写的。
sentences.traditional: 三天後，李時收到了一封信，是“霍桑”寫的。
sentences.pinyin: sān tiān hòu lǐ shí shōu dào le yì fēng xìn shì huò sāng xiě de
sentences.english: And Xiaofeng, of course couldn’t say anything about these circumstances.

sentences.simplified: 信很短，上面写着：
sentences.traditional: 信很短，上面寫著：
sentences.pinyin: xìn hěn duǎn shàng miàn xiě zhe
sentences.english: Three days later, Li Shi received a letter, written by “Huo Sang”.

sentences.simplified: “那天晚上的‘鬼手’，不是鬼，而是你的好朋友朱龙。
sentences.traditional: “那天晚上的‘鬼手’，不是鬼，而是你的好朋友朱龍。
sentences.pinyin: nà tiān wǎn shang de guǐ shǒu bú shì guǐ ér shì nǐ de hǎo péng you zhū lóng
sentences.english: The letter was very short, and on it was written:

sentences.simplified: 他这么做，是想要偷走你脖子上辟邪的小宝物。”
sentences.traditional: 他這麼做，是想要偷走你脖子上辟邪的小寶物。”
sentences.pinyin: tā zhè me zuò shì xiǎng yào tōu zǒu nǐ bó zi shang bì xié de xiǎo bǎo wù
sentences.english: “The ‘ghost hand’ that night, wasn’t a ghost, but your good friend Zhu Long.

sentences.simplified: 和信在一起的，还有一本笔记本。
sentences.traditional: 和信在一起的，還有一本筆記本。
sentences.pinyin: hé xìn zài yì qǐ de hái yǒu yí běn bǐ jì běn
sentences.english: He did this because he wanted to steal away the small treasure on your neck that wards off evil spirits.”

sentences.simplified: 李时发现，这是他曾祖父的笔记本。
sentences.traditional: 李時發現，這是他曾祖父的筆記本。
sentences.pinyin: lǐ shí fā xiàn zhè shì tā zēng zǔ fù de bǐ jì běn
sentences.english: Together with the letter, was also a notebook.

sentences.simplified: 他不明白这本他从来没有见过的笔记本，怎么会到了霍桑手中。
sentences.traditional: 他不明白這本他從來沒有見過的筆記本，怎麼會到了霍桑手中。
sentences.pinyin: tā bù míng bai zhè běn tā cóng lái méi yǒu jiàn guò de bǐ jì běn zěn me huì dào le huò sāng shǒu zhōng
sentences.english: Li Shi found that this was his paternal great-grandfather’s notebook.

sentences.simplified: 他摇摇头，把笔记本放到了一边。
sentences.traditional: 他搖搖頭，把筆記本放到了一邊。
sentences.pinyin: tā yáo yáo tóu bǎ bǐ jì běn fàng dào le yì biān
sentences.english: He didn’t understand how this notebook that he had never seen before had reached Huo Sang’s hands.

sentences.simplified: 这位每天只知道玩儿的李时先生，从来没有想过要好好读一读这本笔记本。
sentences.traditional: 這位每天只知道玩兒的李時先生，從來沒有想過要好好讀一讀這本筆記本。
sentences.pinyin: zhè wèi měi tiān zhǐ zhī dào wán'r de lǐ shí xiān sheng cóng lái méi yǒu xiǎng guò yào hǎo hǎo dú yī dú zhè běn bǐ jì běn
sentences.english: He shook his head and put the notebook to the side.

sentences.simplified: 所以他到最后也没能知道，铜像、钻石还有那“鬼手”的真正目的……
sentences.traditional: 所以他到最後也沒能知道，銅像、鑽石還有那“鬼手”的真正目的……
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ tā dào zuì hòu yě méi néng zhī dào tóng xiàng zuàn shí hái yǒu nà guǐ shǒu de zhēn zhèng mù dì
sentences.english: This Mr. Li Shi that only knew to have fun every day, never thought that he should read this notebook carefully.
So in the end, he also didn’t find out about the bronze statue, the diamonds or the real goal of that ghost hand…

raw.synopsis: This is Part 8 of our rendition of “Ghost Hand”.
sentence_translations: Huo Sang opened the box, and inside it was a very small notebook and a small bag.
The notebook was written full of words. Huo Sang thought that these words had to be written by Li Dan.
He sat down on the sofa and finished reading the words in the notebook with the highest speed.
He found that this was a very grand navy project!
Huo Sang came to think of what Li Shi had said, that his paternal great-grandfather and Li Hongzhang were good friends, ..
.. and that he previously had suggested a grand proposal to Li Hongzhang.
But Li Hongzhang hadn’t listened to what he said.
Now it seemed like that grand proposal had to be the navy project in this notebook.
Although this project really didn’t have that much use by now, ..
.. but if this project could have been realized at that time, maybe the First Sino-Japanese War wouldn’t have been lost.
On the last page in the notebook, were the words that Li Dan wanted to say to his descendants.
On it was written: Descendants, if there is an opportunity in the future, it’s necessary that you implement this navy project.
In the small bag there are ten diamonds I got in Germany.
These diamonds have to be used for assisting the country to implement this navy project, and can’t be used someplace else.
Huo Sang opened the small bag, and sure enough, there were ten beautiful diamonds inside.
Seeing the diamonds brought light to Huo Sang’s eyes.
Also Miss Xiaofeng beside him, who had never ever seen diamonds, ..
.. even had her mouth open, and not a word came out.
Huo Sang gave Xiaofeng a glance, put the diamonds back in the small bag, ..
.. then put both the notebook and the small bag in his own pocket.
Subsequently, he put back the bronze statue’s head in its original place and covered it once more with the red cloth.
Now, the bronze statue seemed the same way as if it had never been touched.
Huo Sang said to Xiaofeng:
“Today was exhausting for you. Now you can go back to your room and sleep.
These diamonds, regard them as hush money for me.
Moreover, that lover of yours Zhu doesn’t have anything good about him at all, you have to be careful.”
Xiaofeng slowly faced the door and walked away, reaching the door, she turned back her head again and asked:
“Mr. Huo, aren’t you going to return those diamonds to the master?”
Huo Sang raised his head, and said with a light smile: “Why should I return them? It’s diamonds that I found.”
When Xiaofeng heard that, she said a bit angrily:
“You are the nationwide famous great detective Huo Sang indeed! How can you do this?”
Huo Sang smiled, and said: “Who told you I was Huo Sang?”
“You’re not Mr. Huo? Then… Then who are you?”
Xiaofeng looked at this person before her eyes, so scared that her voice started trembling completely.
“Haha! I’m a master thief, or, you can call me – a thief?
I merely saw that Huo Sang’s office was empty that day, sneaked in to “seize” some things, ..
.. just in time to receive the phone call about your master…”
“Then your name is…?” Xiaofeng then asked.
This master thief didn’t answer, just smiled at her, slowly walked out the room, and left this small Western-style house.
Xiaofeng only remembered, when he passed her, that mark on his ear, that was particularly big and particularly red.
No one knew about the matter of this evening, other than Miss Xiaofeng.
And Xiaofeng, of course couldn’t say anything about these circumstances.
Three days later, Li Shi received a letter, written by “Huo Sang”.
The letter was very short, and on it was written:
“The ‘ghost hand’ that night, wasn’t a ghost, but your good friend Zhu Long.
He did this because he wanted to steal away the small treasure on your neck that wards off evil spirits.”
Together with the letter, was also a notebook.
Li Shi found that this was his paternal great-grandfather’s notebook.
He didn’t understand how this notebook that he had never seen before had reached Huo Sang’s hands.
He shook his head and put the notebook to the side.
This Mr. Li Shi that only knew to have fun every day, never thought that he should read this notebook carefully.
So in the end, he also didn’t find out about the bronze statue, the diamonds or the real goal of that ghost hand…
